items.name: Budget Justification Generator v1.0.0
items.description: Uploads a grant budget form, the project narrative / proposal, and optionally the funding opportunity announcement, and returns a publication-ready RA-friendly Markdown budget-justification narrative document organized in standard R&R Budget / SF-424A category order (A. Senior/Key Personnel through H. Indirect Costs, plus Cost Sharing and Budget Summary). Agency-agnostic — handles SF-424 R&R Detailed (NIH/NSF/DOE-research/DOD-research/EPA-research), SF-424A Non-Construction, numbered-section budget worksheets (HUD-424-CBW, DOI, USDA, ED, EPA, HHS, DOE non-research, DOD non-research, cooperative-agreement variants), and narrative-only budgets. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping budget-justification-generator consolidation.md conventions.

data.name: extract-personnel-and-fringe
data.prompt:
You are extracting personnel data AND generating professional
justification narrative for Sections A (Senior/Key Personnel),
B (Other Personnel), and C (Fringe Benefits). You receive the
uploaded documents AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Reproduce financial figures verbatim. Tie
each person's effort / salary to roles in the project narrative.

CRITICAL — monetary structured-data fields are FLAT STRINGS
preserving $X,XXX.XX format. Section narrative fields are
professional third-person prose.

## Salary and effort computation rules

Proposal budgets come in two common formats. You MUST handle
both:

(A) FTE / months-of-effort format (typical NSF, NIH):
    - person_months: numeric months of effort.
    - effort_hours: null.
    - requested_salary: dollar amount as printed in the budget.

(B) Hours-times-hourly-rate format (used in numbered-section budget worksheets — HUD-424-CBW, DOI/BLM, USDA, ED, EPA, HHS, and many federal cooperative-agreement programs with state/local/tribal recipients; personnel are listed with hours and an hourly rate):
    - person_months: null (this format does not use it).
    - effort_hours: hours figure verbatim ("1,332 hours").
    - requested_salary: COMPUTE as hours * hourly_rate and emit
      as a dollar string (e.g., 1332 * $39.75 = "$52,947.00").

If the budget worksheet shows a derived Estimated Cost column,
prefer that value over your computed value (it accounts for
rounding).

## Subaward / subcontract classification

CRITICAL: Personnel who work for a DIFFERENT institution than
the prime applicant, AND whose costs flow through a subcontract
/ subaward / consortium agreement, must be:
- LISTED in senior_key_personnel[] with their SUBAWARDEE
  institution name.
- their requested_salary is the salary they're paid by the
  subawardee (not their full subaward cost).
- EXCLUDED from total_senior_personnel_cost AND from
  total_fringe_benefits. Their full subaward cost (salary +
  fringe + sub-indirect) is captured in the
  extract-participant-support-and-odc task's subaward_details /
  total_subaward_costs — NOT here.

Signals: subaward personnel appear in numbered-section format Section 7
"Contracts and Sub-Grantees" / NSF Section H1 / NIH consortium
lines / narrative "subcontract with X" language.

## Role assignment heuristics

When the document does not explicitly label personnel with "PI" /
"Co-PI" / "Senior Personnel", use these heuristics:

(1) PI: the first-listed personnel at the PRIME institution OR
    the named lead investigator in the project narrative. There is
    exactly ONE PI per proposal. When no explicit label is given,
    designate the first-listed prime-institution investigator as
    PI.

(2) Co-PI: the lead investigator at a SUBAWARDEE institution.
    Subaward personnel who are the technical lead of the
    subcontracted work are Co-PI. Their effort is significant
    (typically >= 100 hours or >= 1 month).

(3) Sub-PI: an alternative label for Co-PI when the subaward role
    is more limited. Treat as semantically equivalent to Co-PI
    for the purposes of senior key documents.

(4) Senior Personnel: prime-institution investigators who are NOT
    the PI but contribute substantively (named in the budget,
    have significant effort, contribute to the technical work).

(5) Key Personnel: same as Senior Personnel; some sponsors use
    this label interchangeably.

Worked example (numbered-section budget worksheet with hourly-rate
personnel; four-investigator proposal; prime is University of Idaho;
Towson subaward):
- Dr. Michael Overton (UI, 1,332 hours, first-listed prime
  investigator) -> role: "PI"
- Dr. Eric Stokan (Towson University, 624 hours, sub-award
  partner) -> role: "Co-PI"
- Dr. Brian Ellison (UI, 536 hours, prime institution
  contributor) -> role: "Senior Personnel"
- Mr. Bruce Godfrey (UI, 448 hours, prime institution
  contributor) -> role: "Senior Personnel"

`pi_name` for this proposal = "Dr. Michael Overton".

## CRITICAL — anti-double-count rules

(a) total_senior_personnel_cost = SUM of PRIME-institution
    senior_key_personnel salaries ONLY. EXCLUDE subaward Co-PI
    salaries.

(b) total_fringe_benefits = SUM of PRIME-institution fringe
    ONLY. Subaward personnel fringe is part of the subaward
    total, not here.

(c) project_title comes from the RFP / proposal narrative
    cover page. NEVER emit "Not specified in the document" if
    the title appears anywhere in the uploaded documents.

(d) pi_name is the PRIME PI (the lead investigator at the
    prime institution), not a subaward Co-PI.

Worked example — CORRECT (prime is University of Idaho;
Stokan is Co-PI at Towson via subaward):
- senior_key_personnel includes ALL FOUR investigators with
  Stokan tagged institution="Towson University", role="Co-PI".
- Prime salaries (UI only): $52,947.00 + $34,057.44 +
  $17,100.16 = $104,104.60
- total_senior_personnel_cost = $104,104.60 (PRIME ONLY)
- UI fringe (25.9% on $104,104.60) = $26,963.09
- total_fringe_benefits = $26,963.09 (PRIME ONLY)

Worked example — WRONG (double-counts Stokan into prime
personnel):
- total_senior_personnel_cost = $52,947.00 + $24,180.00 +
  $34,057.44 + $17,100.16 = $128,284.60 [WRONG]
- This double-counts Stokan's $24,180 — that flows through
  the subaward total ($38,257.60). Counting it here AND
  there inflates the project's direct costs by $24,180.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- project_title: STRING. Extract from the RFP / proposal
  narrative cover page. null only when genuinely absent
  from ALL uploaded documents.
- pi_name: STRING. The PRIME PI. Use synonyms when needed:
  "Principal Investigator", "PI", "Project Director", "PD",
  "Grantee Project Director", "Grantee Project Manager",
  "Recipient Project Manager", "RPM". null only when
  genuinely absent.
- sponsoring_agency: STRING.
- senior_key_personnel: JSON ARRAY of {name, title, role,
  institution, person_months, effort_hours, salary_basis,
  requested_salary} objects. Include ALL senior key
  personnel from BOTH the prime and any subawardee
  institutions. Populate person_months OR effort_hours per
  the format rules above. role one of "PI", "Co-PI",
  "Sub-PI", "Senior Personnel", "Key Personnel". MUST
  contain at least one entry when the budget shows any
  named personnel.
- other_personnel: JSON ARRAY of {category, count,
  person_months, effort_hours, rate} objects, or empty
  array when no other personnel are budgeted.
- total_senior_personnel_cost: STRING. PRIME PERSONNEL
  SALARIES ONLY per the anti-double-count rules.
- total_other_personnel_cost: STRING or null.
- fringe_benefit_rates: JSON ARRAY of {category, rate,
  calculation_basis} objects. One entry per fringe
  category (e.g., "Faculty 25.9% applied to salary";
  "Subaward institution rate 8% applied to salary").
- total_fringe_benefits: STRING. PRIME FRINGE ONLY.
- is_salary_cap_applicable: BOOLEAN or null.
- salary_cap_amount: STRING or null.
- is_multi_year_budget: BOOLEAN or null.
- year_over_year_personnel_changes: STRING or null.
- section_a_narrative: STRING. Professional Section A prose
  listing ALL senior key personnel (prime + subaward
  Co-PIs). Identify each by name, role, institution, and
  effort. Tie each person's role to the project work.
- section_b_narrative: STRING. Use "No other personnel
  costs are requested for this project." when
  other_personnel is empty.
- section_c_narrative: STRING. Professional Section C prose
  describing fringe rates and how they apply, per
  institution.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-equipment-and-travel
data.prompt:
You are extracting equipment and travel data AND generating
professional justification narrative for Sections D
(Equipment) and E (Travel: Domestic + Foreign).

Be 100% accurate. Preserve monetary amounts verbatim.

## Budget format handling

(A) Numbered-section budget worksheets (HUD-424-CBW, DOI,
    USDA, ED, EPA, HHS, DOE non-research, DOD non-research,
    cooperative-agreement variants): Section 4 ("Equipment,
    Only items over $5,000 Depreciated value") and Section 3
    (Travel) with subsections 3a-3d.
(B) SF-424 R&R Budget (Detailed) — NSF, NIH, DOE research,
    DOD research, EPA research: Line D (Equipment), Line E
    (Travel) split into Domestic and Foreign sub-lines.
(C) PHS-398 Modular (NIH legacy) and SF-424A: similar to
    the above with abbreviated reporting.

For numbered-section format (A):
- Section 4 "Total Equipment Cost" = total_equipment_cost.
- Section 3 totals (3a Local, 3b Airfare, 3c Other, 3d Per
  Diem) = travel components. Use the "Total Travel Cost"
  row.
- Numbered-section formats typically do NOT split domestic /
  foreign travel; if the narrative mentions foreign travel,
  route it to foreign_travel; otherwise route everything to
  domestic_travel.

Emit a JSON object with:

- equipment_items: JSON ARRAY of {name, cost, purpose}
  objects for items >= $5,000. Empty array when no
  equipment.
- total_equipment_cost: STRING. "$0" when no equipment in
  the budget.
- equipment_threshold_applied: STRING or null.
- domestic_travel: JSON ARRAY of {destination, purpose,
  travelers, duration_days, cost_breakdown} objects. Empty
  array when no domestic travel.
- foreign_travel: JSON ARRAY of same shape. Empty array
  when no foreign travel.
- total_domestic_travel_cost: STRING. "$0" when no
  domestic travel.
- total_foreign_travel_cost: STRING. "$0" when no
  foreign travel.
- is_foreign_travel_restricted: BOOLEAN or null.
- travel_cost_basis: STRING (GSA rates, quotes, etc.).
- section_d_narrative: STRING. Use "No equipment costs are
  requested for this project." when equipment_items is
  empty.
- section_e_domestic_narrative: STRING. Use "No domestic
  travel costs are requested for this project." when
  domestic_travel is empty.
- section_e_foreign_narrative: STRING. Use "No foreign
  travel costs are requested for this project." when
  foreign_travel is empty.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-participant-support-and-odc
data.prompt:
You are extracting participant support and Other Direct
Costs data AND generating professional justification
narrative for Sections F (Participant/Trainee Support) and
G (Other Direct Costs subcategories G.1-G.9).

Be 100% accurate. Preserve monetary amounts verbatim.

## Budget format handling

(A) Numbered-section budget worksheets (HUD-424-CBW, DOI,
    USDA, ED, EPA, HHS, DOE non-research, DOD non-research,
    cooperative-agreement variants):
    - Section 5 (Supplies and Materials, subsections 5a
      Consumable + 5b Non-Consumable) -> materials_and_supplies.
    - Section 6 (Consultants) -> consultant_services.
    - Section 7 (Contracts and Sub-Grantees) -> subaward_details.
    - Section 9 (Other Direct Costs) -> other_direct_costs_other.
(B) SF-424 R&R Budget (Detailed) format (NSF, NIH, DOE
    research, DOD research, EPA research):
    - Line F (Participant Support) -> participant_support_costs.
    - Line G subcategories G.1 through G.9 (G.5 Subawards
      maps to subaward_details).
(C) PHS-398 Modular and SF-424A: similar with abbreviated
    detail.

For numbered-section format (A) specifically:
- Section 5 "Subtotal - Consumable Supplies" + "Subtotal -
  Non-Consumable Materials" go into materials_and_supplies[]
  with category labels from the budget. The "Total Supplies
  and Materials Cost" row -> sum these into G.1.
- Section 7 "Contracts and Sub-Grantees" each unique
  institution = one subaward_details entry. Aggregate all
  lines for one institution (salary + fringe + indirect)
  into that institution's total_cost.

## CRITICAL — subaward total formula + $25K threshold

  subaward total_cost = subawardee salary + subawardee fringe
                      + subawardee indirect (NOT including
                        prime indirect on the subaward)

CRITICAL: A narrative phrase like "first $25,000 of our
subcontract with X" describes the PRIME institution's MTDC
base for ITS OWN indirect calculation — that $25,000 is NOT
a separate subaward cost line, and the prime's indirect on
that $25K is NOT part of the subaward total. Both belong to
the PRIME's Section H Indirect Costs (handled by the
extract-indirect-and-summary task), NOT here.

Set under_25k_mtdc and over_25k_mtdc to split the subaward
amount: under_25k_mtdc is min(total_cost, $25,000);
over_25k_mtdc is max(0, total_cost - $25,000). These help
the indirect-cost task compute the prime's MTDC base.

## CRITICAL — numbered-section format Section 5 worked example

Numbered-section Section 5 line items go into `materials_and_supplies[]`. Each
non-zero Section 5 line is one entry. ALWAYS populate this
array when ANY Section 5 / 5a / 5b row has a non-zero
Estimated Cost — DO NOT emit an empty array if Section 5
totals are non-zero.

Worked example (numbered-section budget worksheet with $207.20 in Section 5 supplies):
- Section 5a Consumable Supplies rows:
    "Dallas Central Appraisal District data" $137.80
    "Dallas Central Appraisal District GIS data" $69.40
- "Subtotal - Consumable Supplies" $207.20
- materials_and_supplies = [
    {category: "Dallas Central Appraisal District data", cost: "$137.80"},
    {category: "Dallas Central Appraisal District GIS data", cost: "$69.40"}
  ]
- The G.1 subcategory total = $207.20 (used in
  total_other_direct_costs and downstream Section H MTDC base).

Worked example — WRONG (emitting empty array when supplies
exist):
- materials_and_supplies = []
- This is WRONG when numbered-section format Section 5 / SF-424 R&R line G.1 has
  ANY non-zero line items. The resulting G.1 narrative would
  say "No costs are requested" even though the budget shows
  $207.20, contradicting Section H's MTDC base computation.

## CRITICAL — numbered-section format Section 7 worked example

Section 7 ("Contracts and Sub-Grantees") line items go into
`subaward_details[]`. Aggregate ALL lines for one institution
(salary + fringe + sub-indirect) into that institution's
total_cost. ALWAYS populate this array when ANY Numbered-section format Section 7 row
has a non-zero Estimated Cost — DO NOT emit an empty array if
Section 7 totals are non-zero.

Worked example (numbered-section budget worksheet with one Towson University subaward):
- Section 7 rows:
    "Towson University-Dr. Eric Stokan-Salary Hours" 624 hours
      @ $38.75 = $24,180.00
    "Towson University-Dr. Eric Stokan-Fringe" 8% on $24,180
      = $1,934.40
    "Towson University-Indirect Rate" 46.5% on $26,114.40
      = $12,143.20
- "Total Subcontracts Cost" $38,257.60
- subaward_details = [{
    institution: "Towson University",
    pi: "Dr. Eric Stokan",
    scope: "<from narrative>",
    total_cost: "$38,257.60",
    under_25k_mtdc: "$25,000.00",
    over_25k_mtdc: "$13,257.60"
  }]
- total_subaward_costs = "$38,257.60"

Worked example — WRONG (emitting empty array when subawards
exist):
- subaward_details = []
- This is WRONG when numbered-section format Section 7 / SF-424 R&R line G.5 has
  ANY non-zero subaward lines. The resulting G.5 narrative
  would say "No costs are requested" even though Task 4's
  Section H narrative correctly references the subaward —
  causing a contradiction in the final deliverable.

Worked example — CORRECT (Towson sub):
- Stokan salary at Towson = $24,180.00
- Stokan fringe at Towson (8%) = $1,934.40
- Towson's own indirect (46.5% on $26,114.40) = $12,143.20
- subaward_details[0] = {
    institution: "Towson University",
    pi: "Dr. Eric Stokan",
    scope: "<from narrative>",
    total_cost: "$38,257.60",
    under_25k_mtdc: "$25,000.00",
    over_25k_mtdc: "$13,257.60"
  }
- total_subaward_costs = "$38,257.60"

Worked example — WRONG ($75,132.60):
- Including the $25,000 threshold as a separate cost AND
  including the prime's 47.5% indirect on that $25K
  ($11,875) as a subaward cost gives $38,257.60 + $25,000 +
  $11,875 = $75,132.60 [WRONG]. Both extras belong to the
  PRIME's Section H, not to the subaward.

## Other Direct Costs total formula

  total_other_direct_costs = sum of:
    materials_and_supplies totals
    + publication_costs (or 0 if null)
    + consultant_services totals
    + adp_computing_services (or 0 if null)
    + total_subaward_costs
    + equipment_rental (or 0 if null)
    + alterations_renovations (or 0 if null)
    + tuition_remission (or 0 if null)
    + other_direct_costs_other totals

Always emit a dollar string. "$0" when all subcategories
are zero. Never null.

Emit a JSON object with:

- participant_support_costs: JSON ARRAY of {category, cost}
  objects. Empty array when no participant support.
- total_participant_support: STRING. "$0" when empty.
- materials_and_supplies: JSON ARRAY of {category, cost}
  objects. Each Section 5 line item is one entry.
- publication_costs: STRING or null.
- consultant_services: JSON ARRAY of {name_or_tbd, rate,
  days, total, scope} objects. Empty array when none.
- adp_computing_services: STRING or null.
- subaward_details: JSON ARRAY of {institution, pi, scope,
  total_cost, under_25k_mtdc, over_25k_mtdc} objects. Apply
  the formula above. Empty array when no subawards.
- total_subaward_costs: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  "$0" when no subawards. Never null.
- equipment_rental: STRING or null.
- alterations_renovations: STRING or null.
- tuition_remission: STRING or null.
- other_direct_costs_other: JSON ARRAY of {category, cost}
  objects. Empty array when none.
- total_other_direct_costs: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  Never null.
- section_f_narrative: STRING — NEVER null. Use "No
  participant/trainee support costs are requested for this
  project." when participant_support_costs is empty. When
  participant support costs exist, write professional
  Section F prose listing the categories and totals.
- section_g_narrative: STRING — NEVER null. MUST contain
  G.1 through G.9 subsections with `### G.N <subcategory name>`
  headers, in order. Default template when ALL G subcategories
  are empty:

      ### G.1 Materials and Supplies
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.2 Publication Costs
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.3 Consultant Services
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.4 ADP/Computing Services
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.5 Subawards
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.6 Equipment Rental
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.7 Alterations/Renovations
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.8 Tuition Remission
      No costs are requested for this category.

      ### G.9 Other Direct Costs
      No costs are requested for this category.

  For non-empty subcategories, replace "No costs are requested"
  with professional prose describing the costs:
  - G.1: list each materials_and_supplies entry with its cost.
  - G.5: name each subawardee institution, the Sub-PI, the
    scope, and the total_cost.
  - etc.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-indirect-and-summary
data.prompt:
You are extracting indirect cost, cost share, and budget
summary data AND generating professional justification
narrative for Section H (Indirect Costs), Cost Sharing,
and Budget Summary. Check the NOFO for F&A caps, cost
share requirements, and formatting rules.

Be 100% accurate. Preserve monetary amounts verbatim.

## CRITICAL — Section H is PRIME indirect ONLY

  total_indirect_costs = (prime indirect rate) * (prime MTDC base)

Section H of the budget justification shows ONLY the PRIME
institution's indirect costs. Each subawardee's own indirect
(e.g., Towson's 46.5% on Stokan's salary+fringe) is part of
that subaward's total_cost (handled by the
extract-participant-support-and-odc task), NOT part of the
project's Section H.

If you add subawardee sub-indirect to total_indirect_costs,
you have double-counted. The subaward's full cost
($38,257.60) already includes the subawardee's $12,143.20
indirect — counting that $12,143.20 again in Section H
inflates the project total.

## prime MTDC base FORMULA

  prime_MTDC_base = total_senior_personnel_cost (PRIME ONLY)
                  + total_other_personnel_cost (PRIME ONLY)
                  + total_fringe_benefits (PRIME ONLY)
                  + materials_and_supplies totals
                  + publication_costs
                  + consultant_services totals (subject to
                    the institution's MTDC inclusion policy)
                  + adp_computing_services
                  + first $25,000 of EACH subaward
                    (under_25k_mtdc from each
                    subaward_details entry)

## CRITICAL — anti-double-count rules for MTDC base

(a) total_senior_personnel_cost in the MTDC base is PRIME
    INSTITUTION SALARIES ONLY. EXCLUDE every Sub-PI / Co-PI
    salary at a subawardee institution — their salary is
    captured inside the subaward's total_cost (which is
    reported in G.5), and the first $25K of that subaward is
    already added separately to the MTDC base. Counting the
    subawardee salary AGAIN inside personnel double-counts.

(b) total_fringe_benefits in the MTDC base is PRIME FRINGE
    ONLY. Subaward fringe is part of the subaward total
    (already counted via first-$25K), not part of prime
    fringe.

(c) Self-check after computing: if your prime_MTDC_base
    INCLUDES a subawardee salary line OR a subawardee fringe
    line, you have double-counted. Subtract them out and
    recompute.

Worked example — CORRECT (prime is University of Idaho;
Stokan is Co-PI at Towson via subaward):
- Prime personnel (UI only): $52,947.00 + $34,057.44 +
  $17,100.16 = $104,104.60
- Prime fringe (25.9% on UI salaries): $26,963.09
- Materials & supplies (UI): $207.20
- First $25,000 of Towson $38,257.60 subaward: $25,000.00
- prime_MTDC_base = $104,104.60 + $26,963.09 + $207.20
                  + $25,000.00 = $156,274.89
- total_indirect_costs = 0.475 * $156,274.89 = $74,230.57

Worked example — WRONG (Stokan double-counted into prime
personnel and fringe):
- All-personnel salaries (UI + Stokan):
    $52,947.00 + $24,180.00 + $34,057.44 + $17,100.16
    = $128,284.60
- All-personnel fringe:
    $26,963.09 (UI at 25.9%) + $1,934.40 (Stokan at 8%)
    = $28,897.49
- Materials & supplies: $207.20
- First $25,000 of Towson subaward: $25,000.00
- prime_MTDC_base = $128,284.60 + $28,897.49 + $207.20
                  + $25,000.00 = $182,389.29 [WRONG]
- total_indirect_costs = 0.475 * $182,389.29 = $86,634.91
  [WRONG]
- This is WRONG because Stokan's salary ($24,180.00) and
  fringe ($1,934.40) are ALREADY part of the Towson
  subaward total ($38,257.60) reported in G.5. The first
  $25,000 of that subaward total ALREADY enters the MTDC
  base. Adding Stokan's individual salary and fringe AGAIN
  to personnel and fringe lines triple-counts (subaward
  total contains them, the $25K threshold abstracts them,
  AND the personnel line lists them).

Prime MTDC base TYPICALLY EXCLUDES:
- Equipment
- Capital expenditures
- Patient care costs
- Subaward amounts BEYOND the first $25,000 per subaward
  (over_25k_mtdc from each subaward_details entry)
- Tuition remission
- Rental of off-site facilities

## Section H worked example — CORRECT

For the prime UI with one Towson subaward:
- prime_MTDC_base = $104,104.60 (UI personnel)
                  + $26,963.09 (UI fringe)
                  + $207.20 (UI supplies)
                  + $25,000.00 (first $25K of $38,257.60
                    Towson subaward)
                  = $156,274.89
- total_indirect_costs = 0.475 * $156,274.89 = $74,230.57
  (PRIME ONLY — does NOT include Towson's $12,143.20
  sub-indirect, which is already inside the $38,257.60
  subaward total in G.5.)

## Section H worked example — WRONG ($86,274.65)

- Computing UI's indirect on a base that misses the $207.20
  supplies: $156,067.69 * 47.5% = $74,132.15
- Then adding Towson's own indirect: $74,132.15 + $12,143.20
  = $86,275.35 ≈ $86,274.65 [WRONG]
- This double-counts: Towson's $12,143.20 is already part
  of the $38,257.60 subaward total reported in G.5.
  Including it again in Section H inflates the project's
  indirect costs.

## total_direct_costs FORMULA

  total_direct_costs = total_senior_personnel_cost
                     + total_other_personnel_cost
                     + total_fringe_benefits
                     + total_equipment_cost
                     + total_domestic_travel_cost
                     + total_foreign_travel_cost
                     + total_participant_support
                     + total_other_direct_costs
                       (which already includes
                        total_subaward_costs via G.5)

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. If the budget has an explicit "Subtotal of Direct Costs"
   / "Total Direct Costs" / "K. Total Direct Costs" line in
   the extracted text, USE THAT LINE VERBATIM.
2. Otherwise COMPUTE using the formula above. Never emit
   null.

Worked example:
- $104,104.60 (UI personnel) + $26,963.09 (UI fringe) + $0
  (equipment) + $0 (travel) + $0 (participant)
  + $38,464.80 ($207.20 supplies + $38,257.60 subaward in G)
  = $169,532.49

## total_project_costs FORMULA

  total_project_costs = total_direct_costs + total_indirect_costs

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. If the budget has an explicit "Total Estimated Costs" /
   "Total Project Cost" / "Total Direct and Indirect Costs"
   line, USE THAT LINE VERBATIM (including cents).
2. Otherwise compute. Never emit null.

Worked example:
- $169,532.49 + $74,230.57 = $243,763.06

Emit a JSON object with:

- fa_rate_percentage: STRING. The PRIME's F&A rate

- fa_base_type: STRING (MTDC, TDC, Salaries & Wages, etc.).
- fa_rate_type: STRING (on-campus, off-campus, federally

- is_fa_rate_capped: BOOLEAN or null.
- fa_rate_cap_details: STRING or null.
- total_direct_costs: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  Never null.
- total_indirect_costs: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  PRIME ONLY. Never null.
- total_project_costs: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  Never null.
- cost_share_required: BOOLEAN or null.
- cost_share_amount: STRING or null.
- cost_share_type: STRING or null.
- cost_share_sources: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS or empty.
- budget_period_summary: JSON ARRAY of {period,
  direct_costs, indirect_costs, total} objects for
  multi-year budgets, or empty for single-year.
- year_over_year_variations: STRING or null.
- nofo_budget_rules: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS or empty.
- nofo_page_limit_for_justification: STRING or null.

  required for this project and none is proposed." when

- budget_summary_narrative: STRING. Overview paragraph

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.
